Client Job Title:  Java Developer 
 Contract Duration:  12 + months 
 Location:  Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19104 
   
 Required Skills 
 The first is what we have been calling a Java Developer . 
 A separate job description is enclosed, but we see the developer as a more junior type of person, even someone right from college if they have an IT degree. 
 Someone who can function more as a generalist and who does not necessarily write code all the time but who can help out in a number of areas and easily move from one area to another. 
 More specifically those areas included in the following decription
  
 Description: 
 Java development background (two to five years ideally, probably no more than five)
 Testing experience , creation of test data , management of test files
 Data conversion, migrating and reconfiguring files from one format to another
 Report generation and creating output files
 Working with SQL queries 
 Experience with development tools ( IBM RAD )
 BA/BS in IT .
